name: deep-search
title: Deep search
description: Use when a question should be answered from the user's own files rather than memory: list all / every X, compare A and B, which has the most or least, what do my documents say. Plans sub-queries, searches step by step, cites every statement.
examples: Which Core i3 models are 12th generation? List them all, sorted
How much did the E3-1225's TDP drop from v3 to v6?
Compare the memory specs of the i7-1255U and the i7-1355U
List every Lunar Lake processor in my docs, sorted by model number
What do my notes and reports say about the 2025 budget, across all documents?
author: Nimo
